
=== MANA BASE (38 front-face lands + 1 MDFC land-backs, 0 truly tapped) ===
  conditional, not counted: Breeding Pool   [you may pay 2 life]
  conditional, not counted: Godless Shrine   [you may pay 2 life]
  conditional, not counted: Hallowed Fountain   [you may pay 2 life]
  conditional, not counted: Overgrown Tomb   [you may pay 2 life]
  conditional, not counted: Temple Garden   [you may pay 2 life]
  conditional, not counted: Watery Grave   [you may pay 2 life]
  accelerants counted: 13  (restricted, excluded: none)
  rituals counted, play simulation only (net burst): dark ritual +2

--- sources model (colour), worst lines (8000 sims over 3 reps, seed 17) ---
  T2 {U}{U}        73.7% ±0.1   Counterspell, Mana Drain
  T3 {G}{G}        79.6% ±0.1   Eternal Witness
  T1 {G}           80.1% ±0.5   Birds of Paradise, Elvish Mystic, Llanowar Elves
  T1 {W}           80.1% ±0.3   Enlightened Tutor, Esper Sentinel, Path to Exile
  T1 {U}           80.6% ±0.3   An Offer You Can't Refuse, Brainstorm, Mystic Remora

--- play simulation, 20000 trials over 3 reps, seed 17 ---
  line                                             on play     on draw        baseline(any N on TN)
  Counterspell T2                                62.8±0.4%   68.2±0.3%     95.2±0.1% / 97.0±0.1%
  Eternal Witness T3                             75.5±0.1%   81.0±0.3%     93.9±0.2% / 96.2±0.1%
  Birds of Paradise T1                           76.7±0.1%   80.3±0.1%     98.0±0.0% / 98.8±0.1%
  Enlightened Tutor T1                           76.6±0.3%   80.3±0.2%     98.0±0.0% / 98.8±0.1%
  An Offer You Can't Refuse T1                   76.9±0.3%   80.6±0.3%     98.0±0.0% / 98.8±0.1%
  Tymna the Weaver on curve                      85.4±0.4%   89.6±0.1%     93.9±0.2% / 96.2±0.1%
  Thrasios, Triton Hero on curve                 71.1±0.2%   75.6±0.2%     95.2±0.1% / 97.0±0.1%

  Diagnosis: a line CLOSE to its baseline is a QUANTITY problem (no land swap will help).
  A line FAR BELOW its baseline is a COLOUR problem (a filter land for that pip is the answer).
  A gap smaller than the two ± beside it is noise, not a finding.

  No mulligan is modelled: every opening seven is kept, so the figures above are FLOORS.
  15.2% of opening sevens hold at most one land (2.5% hold none), off 39 lands in 98.
  Those hands are kept here and shipped back in real play. The share moves with
  land count, so it skews deck-to-deck comparison and not just the level.
